name: Mermaid CLI
verdict: No connector path: it is a local rendering tool that needs no customer account or approval. Run it on your own server and handle Chromium sandboxing in containers; under a day.
needGuide: No — just install it and run mmdc; there is nothing for customers to connect.

auth.detail: Local command-line tool (`mmdc`) that renders Mermaid diagrams to SVG, PNG or PDF. The README mentions no account, API key or login. Network access is only needed to install it, or if a diagram loads icon packs from a URL.

approval.gate: None. Runs on your own machine or server; no customer account connects. Production concerns are Chromium/Puppeteer sandboxing in containers.

scopes.why: Local tool; no authentication or permissions apply.
scopes.summary: None. No authentication or permissions apply.

prerequisites: Account and owner: Any developer who can install Node packages or run a container on the agent's host.
Where you register: No registration. Install with `npm install -g @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli`.
Cost: Free (open source; license not checked)

steps.do: Install Node.js, then run `npm install -g @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli` (Homebrew is no longer supported).
Render a test file with `mmdc -i input.mmd -o output.svg` (or .png / .pdf).
In containers or CI, pass a puppeteer-config.json via `-p` to handle the Linux sandbox issue, or use the official Docker image.
Wrap the CLI as an agent tool: write the diagram text to a temp file, run mmdc and return the output file.
Validate diagram input and limit render time and file size to guard against abuse.

roles.team: Any developer who can install Node packages or run a container on the agent's host.
roles.customer: None. No customer approval or account is needed because rendering is local.

testing: Docker and Podman images and `npx -p @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli mmdc` also work.
Check output on a Linux CI image.

blockers.problem: Headless Chromium sandbox errors on Linux or Docker
blockers.fix: Use the repo's puppeteer-config.json guidance or run the Docker image.

blockers.problem: Needs a Chromium download via Puppeteer, which can fail behind a proxy
blockers.fix: Use an already-installed Chromium as per the known-issues docs.

blockers.problem: Rendering untrusted diagram text on a server
blockers.fix: Sandbox the process and set timeouts.

automation.agentCan: Install the tool, write and render Mermaid diagrams, set up the Docker or CI configuration, and wrap it as a tool.
automation.humanMust: Nothing beyond approving installation on the host.

uncertain: License and exact Node and Chromium version requirements were not read from the page.
